steps.content: [Dream, Xiaofeng's Past. Background: Mountain Path]
Somewhere in the mountains of Eastia, a small group of villagers was climbing upward along a narrow path.

It had snowed just two days ago, and the cold was cutting to the bone. Through the endless white expanse, something flashed past from within the forest, brushing against the branches. The limbs shook violently, dislodging clumps of snow, before everything fell still once more.
One of the travelers shuddered, turning to his companion with a trembling voice.

steps.speaker: Timid Villager
steps.content: Hey... did you hear something?

steps.speaker: Panicking Villager
steps.content: Don't just freeze up! Get a move on! You see those tigers goin' at it? They finish with each other, and we're what's for dinner!
The mountain folk in their straw cloaks and hats jostled each other as they hurried away. In a place they had failed to notice, a pair of eyes hidden beneath the snow watched everything unfold.

Once the humans were gone, she could no longer hold herself up. Her legs gave out, and she slumped against a nearby tree trunk. The wound on her leg tore open again from excessive movement, searing pain igniting through her nerves. Blood was trickling down her calf, staining the white snow at her feet a deepening red.
She needed to move, to find somewhere safe to let her wounds heal... but her body refused to rise. The pain was intensifying, and her consciousness was beginning to fade.
Pain had dulled her senses, so when a gust of wind blew through, making the leaves rustle and sway, only belatedly did she realize that something else lay tangled within the sound.
[Two seconds of silence, then footsteps]

steps.speaker: Muffled Voice
steps.content: You...
[Transition to reality. Present, Eastian mountains]
Birds suddenly take flight. The sound of beating wings pulls the woman from her dream, and her eyes drift open.
The white tiger nestled beside her yawns wide, licks its paw, then coils back up, casting a sideways glance at the person still sleeping soundly against its warmth.
Mmm... Yawn...
The woman stretches with a lazy sigh and drags her fingers idly through the fur beside her. The tiger's sleek, glossy coat is now a rumpled mess.
Before the beast can protest, she finds the sweet spot under its chin. Bribed by the attention, it butts its heavy head contentedly against her palm, pressing in for more.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Heh, a full belly and a warm rock... can't beat that kinda sleep. Right, Meowy?
The white tiger answers with a low rumble.

Xiaofeng gives the tiger's head a pat, then rises to gaze down the mountainside. The sun shines bright today, and the ice and snow are just beginning to thaw. Something seems to surface in her mind, and her expression turns thoughtful.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Weather's mighty fine today. Perfect for heading out and about...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Whaddya think, Meowy? Wanna go see if there's a place more fun than down there?
[Background: Inside MBCC]

N.F. 116, After the Northsnow Manor Incident
Inside the MBCC Bureau
So... year-end crunch time already, huh?
You sit at your desk, eyeing the new stack of documents Nightingale has just deposited there. It glares back at you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. The West District Reconstruction Committee has requested our support. A high-risk individual has been sighted in Syndicate, already responsible for multiple incidents. Both the scope and impact exceed standard parameters.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The West District is only just stabilizing after the BR-002 incident. The Committee is hoping for a swift, quiet apprehension to prevent further destabilization.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Additionally, this year has been... irregular. The general from Paradeisos has submitted repeated requests regarding your paid leave. And your written action reports, compared to last year's volume, have been indeed...
So I should thank them for caring so much about my time off that they're sending me a little performance bonus.
Alright. Let's see where this suspect's gotten to.
[Scene Change: Another Street in Syndicate]
You lead the arrest squad through the district, tracing the trail of crime scenes this vandal leaves in their wake.
The sheer scope and quantity of destruction the target causes leaves a trail impossible to miss. By all logic, tracking them down should be simple, but...
[Quick transition]

steps.speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
steps.content: Two chickens, eighteen pig's trotters, a whole lamb, and those three dumpster cats from out back, just gone! That freak definitely snatched 'em up and ate 'em!

steps.speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
steps.content: Just like that Godz... what? You ain't heard of it? Guess imports ain't made it here yet... Hey! I ain't runnin' no bootleg racket! Who's got a projector in this neighborhood anyway? Haha... yeah...

steps.speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
steps.content: Please, you gotta nail this crook! Here, take a bite, take it! Don't be shy now... and you come back anytime, ya hear?
[Quick transition]

steps.speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
steps.content: Between us? They cleaned out the VIP lounge snacks and made off with the tiger claw bracelet from the window. But here's the weird part: they didn't even graze that wobbly dessert stand. I bump it with my hip all the time, and they didn't knock it over? Very odd.

steps.speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
steps.content: Here, this is the set that was taken. Take a look... You're welcome to try it on, of course!

steps.speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
steps.content: You know, that cat's eye fits you really well! No pressure, but I have a feeling about these things. Here's my card. Stay in touch!
[Quick transition]

steps.speaker: Amusement Park Manager
steps.content: Stolen? Nothing was stolen, but eight kids are missing!

steps.speaker: Amusement Park Manager
steps.content: Cameras show nothing, and I haven't seen a soul who looks shifty... I'm more of a wreck about this than you are! We haven't even started counting our damages yet!

steps.speaker: Amusement Park Manager
steps.content: Look at this mess! Popcorn machine's trashed, the seesaw's snapped, duck floaties popped, and the cat mascot suit is just... shredded! Total write-off!

steps.speaker: Amusement Park Manager
steps.content: The mascot suit? Kids love it; they chase it all over. But you need a real big guy to wear it—over six feet, built like a fridge—otherwise the skirt just droops and looks sad. Trade secret, though. You didn't hear it from me.
[Quick transition]

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...That concludes all current intelligence on the target at large in Syndicate.

You stand now at the latest crime scene, a space that used to be a parking lot. Cargo trucks lie in a twisted heap, their cabs crumpled into grotesque shapes, wheels frozen mid-rotation and pointing uselessly at the open sky. It is, by any measure, quite a spectacle.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This was a neutral exchange point for several remaining gangs. Following the West District purge, most of them were eliminated, but some logistical remnants persist.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: These trucks were running contraband between Eastia and DisCity. They likely arrived to offload goods and were intercepted by a third party. They lost the cargo and the fight.
The metal plating of the nearest cargo container bears several gashes, terrifyingly deep, carved into the surface. It is easy to picture the fierce struggle that unfolded here.
You examine the scene and begin building a profile of the suspect from what little you know.
Okay, so we've got fast, we've got stealthy, and based on these marks, we're looking at close to two meters tall with strength to match. Snatches kids, but also swipes alley cats...
The profile only grows more bizarre with each passing minute. You find yourself rubbing your temples again. Whoever this is, they are going to be a nightmare to pin down.

You step closer to the damaged truck. Around your feet, boxes once packed with contraband lie gutted and scattered, their contents spilled across the ground in a careless mess. Something in the corner catches your eye, and your expression hardens into a frown.
...Wait. Food?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Specialty foods and imported snacks. Typically used as cover material layered over the actual contraband from Eastia.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief? Did you find something?
You lean into the cargo box and pluck a short stick from the debris. Dry and brown, the twig shows clear evidence of teeth. Something has worked it over, leaving bite marks along every inch.
What on earth...

You crouch and sweep the scattered debris aside with your hands. Beneath it all, you uncover two ceramic jars where wine still pools at the bottom, several animal skeletons picked clean to the bone, and a rough but thick blanket.
Just as I thought. This is where they started. Someone hitched a ride from Eastia in this shipment.
And as for who...
Nightingale, call the Committee. We need a favor.
Let's set out a welcome mat for our guest.
[Scene Change: Another Street in Syndicate]
A large cargo truck pulls up behind the building. The driver climbs out and knocks on the back door with practiced ease, where someone dressed in black waits just inside.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black
steps.content: You got the goods?

steps.speaker: Freight Driver
steps.content: Obviously. The stuff we brought before was just snacks for the road. This batch is the real thing.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black
steps.content: Good. Anyone tail you?

steps.speaker: Freight Driver
steps.content: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Even brought the "chef" myself. Right there in the truck.
The driver turns and gestures toward someone climbing down from the passenger seat.
The figure in black gives a final nod and orders the inspection to commence. The driver seizes the moment, sidling up to the "chef" to speak in a hushed tone.

steps.speaker: Freight Driver
steps.content: Chief. Still no sign of the target. We going ahead with this?
...Yeah. And next time, lose the banner. Anyone with half a brain would smell a trap.
You glance up at the banner overhead: "Welcome Renowned Eastian Chef for Culinary Guidance." Your collar, starched and stiff from the chef's uniform, digs into your neck. You tug at it.

Nearby, the arrest squad, disguised in black, gathers around the side of the truck. The door creaks open inch by inch. Everyone holds their breath, tense with anticipation, as one team member steps forward and retrieves the strategic resources you specifically requisitioned—
Several authentic Eastian smoked chickens, their skin a perfect golden-brown, their aroma wafting through the air.
Everyone stay sharp. Wait for my signal...
One second. Two seconds... The smell of smoked meat hangs in the air. The back alley goes quiet, so much so that only footsteps break the stillness.
You wait in silence, watching as the box of smoked chickens is lifted out and drawn closer. Just one second before it is carried indoors—
[Tiger's roar and pouncing sound]
A thunderous roar splits the air. An enormous figure swoops over your head and crashes down from the top of the truck!
Now! Move in!!

The cargo truck crumples like a tin toy, metal screeching in protest. From above, a massive net drops and swallows the attacker whole. The arrest squad, hidden and waiting, surges forward to pin their target down.
The attacker thrashes, kicking up clouds of dust with every desperate lunge. The sheer strength nearly shakes the squad loose.
The net tightens, and the struggles slowly fade. You squint through the settling dust at the massive creature, and freeze. That shape. You know that shape. You saw it not long ago. It is...
A tiger?????

steps.speaker: Arrest Squad Member
steps.content: —Argh?!
A scream tears through your ears. You spin, only to find squad members crumpling beside you, bodies folding at wrong angles, swallowed fast by the churning dust.
Human screams, gunfire, and bestial roars echo through the alley. In this critical moment, you have only one choice—
The shackles pulse with faint red light, a dim glow lost in the smoke. You cannot see a thing, but in the next moment, you feel your body lifted into the air.
The world spins around you, then a hard surface presses against your stomach. You belatedly realize that someone has grabbed you off the ground and slung you over their shoulder.
The Mountain Lord graces DisCity with her presence—
Hey, Tiny. It's been a while! Miss me?
Are you out of your mind?! Put me down, now!!! —Ugh!

Upside down, the world is nothing but chaos and noise. The arrest squad screams, panic and fury tangled together, and then your stomach lurches with another brutal jolt. Xiaofeng lands hard on the truck's roof, already bounding away from the incoming blows.

steps.speaker: Arrest Squad Member
steps.content: Get the adjutant! Suppressing fire! Get the Chief back!

steps.speaker: Tiger
steps.content: Roarrrr...!
Someone charges. Xiaofeng meets them with a single blow and knocks them back. A long roar tears free as her tail whips in a wide arc, scattering every arrest squad member in reach.
Stop it!! Xiaofeng, what are you doing?!
That lazy, delighted voice sounds right above your head like a phantom. You struggle to lift your head and find yourself face to face with a smug, triumphant grin.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: I come all the way from Eastia to play, and this is the welcome I get? No "oh wow, Xiaofeng's here"? No "hey, good to see you"?
A tiger from the Eastian mountains showing up in DisCity isn't a "wow." It's a heart attack! Did you even read the banner?!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Course I read it. Got eyes, don't I? But you humans always say, "Can't catch a wolf without bait." And your traps usually have the good stuff inside...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Guess I caught something even better!
You...!
The world spins before your eyes—ground surging close, then falling away—as Xiaofeng races and leaps between buildings with you slung over her shoulder.
Your stomach churns painfully against her frame. You have never been carried like this. You fight to tighten your core, desperate to keep your head from flopping uselessly in the violent wind.
Wait... Can you not carry me like this... I'm gonna throw up...
You should know better. Of course she sees the banner. Of course she does not have the sense to stay away.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Alright, finders keepers! Sorry, little ones, borrowing your boss for a bit!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Eastia's been boring me to death. But this place is not bad at all. And since I need a guide...
Another sudden leap into the air. Xiaofeng spins you around into a different position, and you find yourself staring directly into her vertical pupils, gleaming with amusement.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hah! Change of plans. I'm here, you're here, so show me around!
